demo.program:
# Bosnia and Herzegovina — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Bosnia and Herzegovina?", "Sarajevo"),
    ("What currency does Bosnia and Herzegovina use?", "Convertible Mark"),
    ("What is capital?", "Sarajevo"),
    ("What is currency?", "Convertible Mark (BAM)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+387"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".ba"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "Europe"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
